name: Signal jammer
body:
Source Technology Guide pg. 52
Price 10,000 gp
Slot none; Weight 8 lbs.
Capacity 24; Usage 1 charge/hour
Description
This small device emits a low, hissing sound when activated. While active, a white noise generator creates a 60-foot-radius spread in which all signals are completely blocked. For more information on signals, see the On Signals sidebar on page 43.
Construction
Craft DC 26; Cost 5,000 gp
Craft Technological Item, production lab
